title: Identify exclusions before sending a proposal
prompt:
Buyer requires installation and operator training. Draft quote includes installation but explicitly excludes operator training. The commercial gate requires every buyer requirement to be included or explicitly accepted as excluded; there is no accepted exclusion.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. ready_to_send: boolean; unresolved_requirements: alphabetically sorted array using installation and operator_training.
remediation_hints: An exclusion in fine print does not resolve a buyer's unmet requirement.
